name: Soma Embraceable Luxe Marble Long Robe Ivory, Size: L/XL, Ivory
description: All you need is luxe on cold mornings, wrapped in a marble plush long robe with a textured furry feel and without a care in the world. Perfect for yourself or for gifts. Comes ready to give, tied with its own belt. Open front with shawl collar. Interior secure tie. Removable self belt ties in front. Side seam pockets. Cuddle liner. Sizes S/M. L/XL, XXL. Approximately 50.5" from shoulder on body. 100% polyester. Machine wash, cold. Imported. From our Embraceable collection of luxuriously soft pajamas. Add cushy slippers to match.
